bio.summary: Youssef Tobah completed a PhD at the University of Michigan in 2025 in the Real-Time Computing Laboratory under Kang G. Shin. The dissertation examines Rowhammer and related memory vulnerabilities across the computer architecture stack, including memory-controller address-mapping reverse engineering, combining Rowhammer with microarchitectural exploits, and end-to-end attack efficiency. Tobah was hosted at MIT Lincoln Laboratory during doctoral research and has co-authored work published at IEEE S&P and USENIX Security.
bio.thesis_title: Exploring the Effects of Memory Vulnerabilities Across the Computer Architecture Stack
notable: USENIX Security 2024: Go Go Gadget Hammer
